strategy: Sneak Attack / cheat big creatures reanimator
identity: Black-Red reanimator that cheats oversized or high-value ETB creatures into play via Sneak Attack and a graveyard-recursion package (Chainer, Dread Return, Necrosavant), backed by Entomb and Vampiric Tutor for consistency.
